title: Let Me Hypnotize You to Confess
description:
In this hypno file, I will very simply guide you to the truth. The secrets at the core of your being. I will make sure you understand that they are part of you, not wrong, just taboo and perhaps not ok for every situation. But when I hypnotize you in this file, you will feel comfortable with revealing something about yourself. A desire, well hidden from others, that you will let come to the surface.

Are you ready for me to hypnotize you for that? Don’t worry, this will be a wholesome, positive experience that encourages you to confess in a safe, healthy way the thoughts you keep inside. And when you do, perhaps making those thoughts tangible will give you a little nudge to reveal them to someone who can make them a reality too.
author: Mistress Calia
